rest--early-night/haru.said: If he talks about home I need some details about home for him to talk about, where is his home, what was it like etc etc.
rest--early-night/haru.did: Named his village (Kinuoka) and gave him two new topics and three new answers: the terraces, the river and the reeling shed, what silkworms sound like at feeding time, and how it felt to be an android nobody ever remarked on at home versus the first thing people notice here.

rest--early-night/grenna.did: Kept as is, except one small change: she now raps her knuckles on wood, so that Mrs Ueda is the only one who knocks twice.

rest--bathhouse/sigrun.said: A very hard fortitude test would be a great compliment to this haunt scene. Allowing players to brave the hot hot tub.
rest--bathhouse/sigrun.did: The hottest-pool event was already a Fortitude save at the plain level DC. It is now a very hard save (level DC +5, so 20 at level 1), with all four outcomes paying and a +1 status bonus against heat and fire for a success. Also removed four leftover 'lukewarm' catchphrase lines.

Two knocks is Mrs Ueda's (it is her opening line and her own event), so it is now hers alone, and only on the door; Grenna raps her knuckles instead.
